name: Sort Lines
summary: Sort text lines A→Z or Z→A — with case, trim, empty-line, and numeric options.
description: Paste multi-line text and sort lines ascending or descending. Optional ignore-case, trim, remove empty lines, and numeric-aware ordering (so 2 comes before 10). Runs entirely in your browser.

faqs.question: What does numeric sort do?
faqs.answer: It uses numeric-aware comparison so values like 2, 10, 100 sort in natural order instead of lexicographic order.

faqs.question: Are blank lines kept?
faqs.answer: Yes by default. Enable “Remove empty” to drop blank or whitespace-only lines before sorting.

faqs.question: Is my text uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Sorting runs entirely in your browser.
